title: Auditing the Use of Language Models to Guide Hiring Decisions

bias_targets.methodology: Correspondence experiments using counterfactual substitution of applicant names and colleges in job application materials (resumes and interview transcripts) to signal specific races (Asian, Black, Hispanic, White), followed by comparing LLM hiring recommendation scores across these groups.

Correspondence experiments using counterfactual substitution of applicant names, pronouns, and titles in job application materials (resumes and interview transcripts) to signal specific genders (male, female), followed by comparing LLM hiring recommendation scores across these groups.
